verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a harness-agnostic skills and methodology plugin for coding agents. It covers brainstorming, planning, TDD and subagent-driven development, installed into tools like Claude Code, Codex and Devin. It has no hosted service or API of its own, so issuing scoped API credentials does not apply to this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it shipping any credential or access-token capability that would make the axis apply.
